lr-eval.policy_spec: JSON object/list, JSONL or YAML of {name, router_mode (kv_router|round_robin), type, parameters (no seed), router_config (KvRouterConfig knobs), seeded?}; the contract form {worker_selection, router_config} is accepted; builtin names: default (= default@defaults: dynamo-default-cost-fn, no parameters), round_robin

record_notes.goodput_rps: A2 good count / native makespan (integrity, contract field)
record_notes.goodput_rps_itl: recomputed token-form goodput / native duration; |rel diff| > 1e-6 vs report -> record error (never cached)
record_notes.goodput_rps_report: native goodput_request_throughput_rps of the replay, called with the token-form SLA (T, I) only
record_notes.goodput_rps_window / good_frac_window: A2 objective metric: windowed (A2.3) good = mean ITL <= I and e2e <= S*E0(ISL,OSL), TTFT only if sla.ttft_ms set
record_notes.guards: LR-13 guard metrics: worker_share_max (+ cap min(2/N,1/N+0.25)), workers_used, worker_prefill_max_over_mean, session_split_frac, session_workers_mean, frac_slowdown_gt_3S, slowdown_clip_mean, frac_ttft_gt_3T, queue_wait_p99_ms
record_notes.isl_buckets: n, good_frac, good_frac_window, ttft_p50/p90, worker_share_max per ISL bucket
record_notes.itl_p50/itl_p90: per-request mean ITL (e2e-ttft)/(osl-1); itl_tok_p99 = native per-token p99
record_notes.per_request_path: gzip JSONL of canonical-order compact rows (no UUID) next to the cache entry (lr-eval default; off in lr-train)
record_notes.rescore: good_frac_window, goodput_rps_window, good_frac at SLO scales 0.5,0.75,1,1.5,2,3 x (I, S[, T]) (LR-08, A2.2)

lr-eval.repeats: CRN replicates k = O..O+K-1 (A1 crn-order-v1): replicate trace from learned_routing.replicates, policy seed k+1 injected as parameters.seed for seeded types (dynamo-default-cost-fn, learned-choice, sticky-session; override with seeded: true|false)
lr-eval.usage: lr-eval --policy-spec SPEC... --cells CELLS.jsonl... --out results.jsonl [--repeats K] [--repeat-offset O] [--slots 20] [--num-slots 20] [--slots-dir DIR] [--max-wall-seconds S] [--timeout-s T] [--no-per-request] [--refresh] [--cell-filter RE] [--shard i/n] [--root CR] [--quiet] | --bundle-out DIR | --ingest DIR [--out F] [--ingest-any-build] | --slots-status

lr-report.statistics: paired ratio to the reference on the same (cell, k); two-stage cluster bootstrap (clusters = cells or segments, then replicates), 95% percentile CI; IQM, geometric mean, wins/losses, dropped pairs; grouped tables; SLO-scale sweep; guard means; ISL buckets; per-cell winner map
lr-report.usage: lr-report --results R.jsonl... --out-dir DIR [--metric goodput_rps_window] [--reference NAME|SHA] [--cluster cell|segment] [--bootstrap 2000] [--seed 0] [--group-by split,holdout_axis,num_workers,family,load_mode] [--policy-filter S] [--split S] [--title T] [--no-figures]

lr-train.budget: --budget-evals counts CMA-ES candidate evaluations; a generation starts only if fevals + popsize <= budget; tasks_requested counts every (spec, cell, k) evaluation incl. reference, validation and re-evaluation
lr-train.crn: per generation one (cell subset, k set) shared by reference and all candidates; k = (g*K + j) mod P; asserted per record (cell_id, repeat, policy_sha)

exit_codes.1: error (incl. resume mismatch, reference replay error)
exit_codes.3: paused by --max-wall-seconds (call again with the same args)

lr-train.objective: mean over cells of mean over k of (m+eps)/(m_ref+eps) [ratio, default] or clip(ln(.), +-ln 3) [clipped_log_ratio, LR-01]; m = --metric, ref = default@defaults on the same (cell, k)
lr-train.space_yaml: base spec + fixed dotted paths + params of kind float|int|vector|matrix|lowrank (context {p,q} rank r), bounds per element or null, scale linear|log, pinned elements (fixed: {i: v}), std (CMA_stds), unit; cma: {sigma0, pycma options}
lr-train.usage: lr-train --space space.yaml --cells train.jsonl... [--val val.jsonl...] --run-dir DIR --budget-evals N --max-wall-seconds S [--popsize L] [--seed s] [--replicates 2] [--replicate-pool 8] [--cells-per-gen M] [--val-every 5] [--val-replicates 3] [--objective ratio|clipped_log_ratio] [--metric goodput_rps_window] [--eps 1e-3] [--reference default|SPEC] [--reeval-frac r] [--slots 20] [--slots-dir DIR] [--keep-per-request] [--cell-filter RE] [--val-filter RE] [--fake-objective PATH=V,...]

corrections_fix_r2.e0: superseded: method ais-chunked-estimator-v2 sums batch-1 decode steps at KV context ISL+j+2 (replay's convention: step j runs at sequence.len() = ISL+j+1 and the mocker's AIS callback evaluates one step at len+1). v1 (ISL+j+1) is unreachable (table file is keyed by method).
corrections_fix_r2.e0_accuracy: the B3 claim 'E2E to <2e-6 relative' (5 probe pairs) understated v1's bias: over 17,233 isolated single-request replays v1 was -1.64e-5..+6.3e-9 relative; v2 is -1.97e-8..+1.65e-8 (runs/build-fix-r2/out/e0_v2_vs_isolated.json)
corrections_fix_r2.e2e_clause: a2_good: e2e <= scale*S*E0*(1+1e-6) (goodput.E2E_REL_TOL); ITL clause unchanged (exact, native-comparable)

decisions: Replay YAML vs identity: the router policy parser rejects unknown top-level keys, so the canonical policy file (with router_mode and the router_config sidecar) is the identity at runs/policies/<policy_sha>.yaml, and replay consumes runs/policies/replay/<sha>.yaml holding only worker_selection with seed k+1.
Cache key adds the replicate protocol (A1) and keeps the policy seed out of policy_sha; the cell content SHA replaces paths by content hashes so bundles and split moves keep cache entries.

A2 scoring: native replay gets only the token-form thresholds (I, and T if set), so goodput_rps_report is the native ITL-only pass (A2.4) cross-checked at 1e-6; the A2 good set adds the E2E slowdown against E0.

E0 = AIS chunked estimator (ais-chunked-estimator-v1); against 5 single-request replays (ISL/OSL 1000/2, 7000/300, 20000/50, 100/1, 120000/20) it matched TTFT to <1e-8 and E2E to <2e-6 relative (runs/build_harness/measure/e0_probe.json); calibration records the E0 method in facts/calibration.json.

Windows default to arrival basis for open loop and completion basis for closed loop/lanes, through the last arrival; calibration sets warmup_ms and window_ms per cell (B2 cells provide measure_trace hints in trace time; divide by speedup).
lr-train objective default is the contract's mean normalized goodput (ratio) on goodput_rps_window; clipped_log_ratio (LR-01) is available and must be chosen and recorded by the training stage.

Errored evaluations are never cached; a reference error aborts the lr-train call (exit 1) rather than scoring candidates against nothing; candidate errors get the generation's worst objective minus 1.

Remote bundles ship the exact local _core.abi3.so in a frozen site/ tree instead of a separately built wheel, so build IDs and cache keys match; glibc floor 2.39 (Ubuntu 24.04) or a container on older nodes.

--max-wall-seconds stops launching replays at the deadline; running replays finish (bounded by their timeout); the first wave may start up to 2 s late and lr-train always attempts one evaluation per call, so short chunks never livelock (found and fixed in this stage).

Workers: one persistent subprocess per pool thread (setup: same-process repeats are deterministic and faster); idle exit 300 s and RSS recycle at 1536 MiB bound memory when several lr-* processes run.
head: <commit-02>

interfaces.build_id: sha256({sha256 of dynamo._core .so, aisimulate version}); memoized by file stat in CR/runs/cache/build_ids.json; workers report theirs and a mismatch fails the job (bindings rebuilt mid-run)
interfaces.bundle: site/ = frozen copy of the exact local dynamo tree incl. _core.abi3.so (same build_id), learned_routing, aisimulate(+core), yaml, typing_extensions; wheels/ = learned_routing sdist+wheel; run.sh = python3.12 -S with PYTHONPATH=site (no venv), --shard i/n; ingest recomputes each key from the record's fields and checks harness_version and build_id
interfaces.cache_key: sha256(canonical JSON {policy_sha, cell_id, cell_sha, repeat, protocol, harness_version, build_id}); CR/runs/cache/results/<k[:2]>/<key>.json; atomic writes; errored records never cached
interfaces.canonical_yaml: sorted keys, repr floats ('.0' inserted before an exponent without a decimal point, e.g. 1.0e-05, so YAML 1.1 and 1.2 parse the same float), strings double-quoted
interfaces.cell_extensions: optional: sla {itl_ms, e2e_slowdown, ttft_ms}; measure {basis arrival|completion, warmup_ms, window_ms} in replay ms; engine_overrides (MockEngineArgs); replay_options (weka_nested_timestamp_basis, trace_shared_prefix_ratio, trace_num_prefix_groups); expected_cost_s; synthetic {...} with trace_format synthetic
interfaces.cell_sha: sha256 of the cell minus split/holdout labels and locations (split, holdout_axis, holdout_axes, selection_exposed, notes, segment, trace_files, engine_ref, trace_sha256, derived_meta) plus trace content sha and engine {mock_engine_args, model} sha; declared trace_sha256 is verified
interfaces.e0: method ais-chunked-estimator-v1: sum of AisSession.predict_prefill(1, new, done) over chunks of max_num_batched_tokens, plus batch-1 decode steps at ctx ISL+j+1 for j < OSL-1; cached in CR/runs/cache/e0/<engine16>-<method>.json (flock merge); nominal engine (engine_overrides do not change E0)
interfaces.load_modes: open_speedup -> arrival_speedup_ratio; open_rate -> request_rate (synthetic) or speedup = rate / native rate (mooncake); closed_concurrency -> replay_concurrency; agentic_lanes -> agentic_lanes (weka; execution_model = engine.json model)
interfaces.policy_identity: policy_sha = sha256(canonical YAML of {router_mode, router_config, worker_selection without seed}) -> CR/runs/policies/<policy_sha>.yaml; replay consumes CR/runs/policies/replay/<sha256>.yaml = {worker_selection} only, seed = k+1 (router parser rejects unknown top-level keys)
interfaces.slot_pool: 20 flock files CR/slots/slot-NN.lock (flock is per open file description, so threads of one process also exclude each other; the kernel drops locks of dead holders); random order, non-blocking polling; holder line 'pid host label time'
interfaces.timeouts: per replay max(120 s, 20 x expected_cost_s) unless --timeout-s; expected cost from cell.expected_cost_s, else 2 s + 1 ms/row (mooncake, synthetic) or 5 s + bytes/5 MB/s (weka)
interfaces.windows: arrival basis (open default): requests arriving in [first+warmup, first+warmup+window_ms or last arrival], late finishers count, incomplete/missing = not good, goodput = good/window length; completion basis (closed/lanes default): good completions in window / window length; zero-length window -> [start, makespan] with window_fallback
interfaces.workers: one persistent `python -m learned_routing.worker` per pool thread, job per stdin line, ack + done protocol on a private stdout; timeout -> SIGKILL to that exact child PID and an error record; crash -> error record; idle exit after LR_WORKER_IDLE_EXIT_S (300 s); recycled after 400 jobs or 1536 MiB peak RSS; first wave of a run may start up to 2 s past --max-wall-seconds (progress guarantee)

known_limitations: Parallel lr-* processes each keep up to --slots workers; with k concurrent lr-train restarts use --slots about 20/k to bound idle memory (full 23.6k-row Mooncake workers peak ~1.1 GiB per the setup audit).

Weka/AgentX replicate traces are materialized as play-per-line JSONL (A1); AgentX scoring paths (lanes, warm-up rebasing) were not exercised with real AgentX cells in this stage (B2's cells arrived during the build).
No key-level lock: two processes that need the same uncached (policy, cell, k) at the same moment both replay it and write identical records.
The report's figures cap line plots at 8 policies (the palette's 8 slots in fixed order); more policies appear in the tables only.

notes: Replay wall at 20-way concurrency: median 1.77-1.81 s per 2000-request replay in 20-replay batches and 1.16 s in the 80-replay batch, vs setup's ~1.0 s sequential in-process; throughput ~11 replays/s for 2000-request cells.

Scoring overhead per replay (eval_wall_s - wall_s), warm E0 table: median 0.19 s (20-replay batch, one job per fresh worker) and 0.08 s (80-replay batch, reused workers); cold E0 table: median 0.59 s.
